beats.text: Polly stands in the open doorway with her back turned, watching a yellow taxi sled drive slowly away across the snow

Polly walks off to the left past the closed door with a sulky frown

beats.text: Polly lies tucked under the covers in bed with a sad frown, blinking and glancing to one side
Polly rolls onto her side and turns away toward the empty half of the bed
